preconditions: The SPI bus must already be configured with board-local pin mapping.
Any board-local card detect or power-enable line should already be stable before probe.
steps: Configure the SPI host bus with board-local pins and DMA policy.
Bind the SD card chip select to the configured SPI host.
Mount the FAT filesystem and read the card CID/CSD identification data.

checks: Initialize the SPI-backed SD card bus.
Read card identification fields such as CID or name.
Mount the card and confirm a directory listing or simple file read succeeds.
smokeTest.passCriteria: The card initializes over SPI and returns readable identification data.
failureNotes: A mount failure may still indicate that the electrical SPI link is alive if CID/CSD reads succeed.
Missing pull-ups or an empty card slot are common causes of detection failure.

highLevel.name: sdcard_mount
highLevel.description: Initialize and mount the SPI-connected microSD card.

highLevel.name: sdcard_get_info
highLevel.description: Read card identification and capacity information.

highLevel.name: sdcard_unmount
highLevel.description: Flush and unmount the mounted microSD card.
